title: DS-CORE is a KV store modelling a property graph for HTAP
context: PO defined engine type (key-value/document), HTAP workload, and that data is a graph of entities with nested attributes and relationships.
decision: Ordered key-value storage. Nodes are labelled documents with nested properties; edges are typed, directed, may carry properties and are stored as out- and in-entries under their endpoint nodes' key prefixes; parallel edges allowed.
